Ravi Menon: Morning — we need to finalize the Optimize Toolkit MVP scope for next 6 weeks. CS is pushing for deployable snippets + clear ROI calc; infra warns about tail latency. Must-ships vs holes? @Grace @Omar

Grace Liu: My read: MVP = (1) per-route batching recs with confidence + expected cost delta, (2) KV-prefix caching TTL suggestions with hit-rate estimate, (3) exportable JSON snippets and 1-page quickstart, (4) eval-triggered alerts -> Slack webhook. Quantization automation = NO for MVP, ship playbook only.

Omar Hassan: Infra constraints: telemetry window = 14 days. We need a tiny simulator to estimate p95/p99 change from batching before surfacing recs. Canary must support traffic tags (<=3%) and auto-revert if p99 increases >25% or paired-eval quality drops >1% absolute. Otherwise ops will push back.

Priya Rao: CS/customer ask: pilot-ready artifacts. Two pilots: HelixHealth (chat) and Draftly (long-form). They want copy-paste Node/Python snippets and a "how to validate" checklist. Also: include a dollar-estimate row in exports so PMs can show ROI quickly.

Ravi Menon: Draft acceptance criteria: A) recommender emits ranked recs (type, confidence, expected_cost_pct, expected_p95_ms, explain), B) JSON export + SDK example for Node/Python, C) eval-alert webhook posts regression events to Slack w/ link to paired-eval, D) docs + 2 pilots onboarded.

Grace Liu: UX note: keep UI table-only — each row one-liner explain + "Export" button. Example export snippet (should be valid):
```json
{"route": "/v1/generate", "batching": {"enabled": true, "max_batch_tokens": 4096, "target_latency_ms": 200}}
```
Make sure SDK accepts this payload.

Omar Hassan: Recommender output schema example inline (one-liner):
`{"route":"/v1/generate","rec_type":"batching","confidence":"0.87","expected_cost_pct":"-14%","expected_p95_ms":30,"explain":"high req rate, low token variance"}`
Keep fields string-friendly for export.

Priya Rao: Pilot gating: run paired-evals on historical prompts before canary; acceptance = <=1% absolute quality regression and p95 change <20% on canary. If either fails, rec marked "review" and not recommended to auto-apply.

Ravi Menon: Prioritization tradeoffs: recommender accuracy requires longer windows and more infra; if we need to cut, cut the simulator (ship without latency sim) and mark recs as "estimate only" — but CS will complain. Any other cuts?

Grace Liu: Another cut option: limit initial recs to high-volume routes only (top 10 routes by tokens/day). That reduces compute and surfaces highest ROI first.

Omar Hassan: Agreed. Also logging: include p95/p99 baseline and post-canary in export so customers can audit. We'll add a small cost model (per-100M tokens -> $X) to give dollar estimates.

Priya Rao: I'll draft pilot emails and two eval sets (chat 50 queries, long-form 20 docs). Will ask HelixHealth about their SLA constraints — they require p95 < 250ms for chat.

ops-bot: Created card OPT-9007 with subtasks: recommender-poc, simulator-optional, sdk-export, eval-webhook, pilot-onboard. Link: https://projects.internal/OPT-9007 :calendar:

Ravi Menon: Decisions: LOCK scope = suggest + export (batching + cache TTLs) + eval webhook to Slack + docs + 2 pilots. Simulator is desirable but optional; initial rollout limited to top-10 routes. Quantization automation deferred; publish playbook only. Action owners: @Grace recommender + export, @Omar infra/simulator & canary, @Priya pilots/docs. We'll revisit full sim/auto-quant next quarter. Closing thread — ping if concerns. :thumbsup:
